title: 门交互限制不合理
description: 只能撬开未损坏的门，损坏的门必须拆解或卸载，限制玩家操作。
evidence: You can only PRY doors that aren't DAMAGED. If it's damaged then you have to either SCRAP it (faster but the door is destroyed) or UNINSTALL it (slower but you can fix it later).
